about.title: About the FandomVerse Project
about.subtitle: The first fandom universe portal to bring together the world's 7 biggest pop-culture categories in one smooth, intuitive Single Page Application (SPA).
about.contestBadge: TechWir Contest — Web Innovation Unleashed (© Aptech Limited)
about.missionP1: Fans used to bounce between dozens of different sites — fan wikis, discussion forums, video channels, gift shops — just to keep up with a single favorite movie or game.
about.missionP2: was created to break down that fragmentation. We bring you one central space where you can dive into in-depth articles, admire stunning photo galleries, watch blockbuster trailers, explore character profiles and keep meaningful memorabilia.
about.tech1Desc: Runs entirely in the browser by preloading highly optimized static JSON datasets.
about.tech2Desc: A smart chatbot handles frequently asked questions and instant navigation without relying on any external AI API.
about.tech3Desc: Optimized for every device from Mobile (375px) to Desktop, strictly following WCAG AA accessibility standards.
about.creditsDesc: This project was built and completed by a contestant in the TechWir technology competition. All illustrative images and videos use openly licensed (royalty-free) sources or official embed links.

contact.faqSubtitle: Quick answers to the questions fans ask most often

faqs.q: How long until I hear back from the editorial team?
faqs.a: The FandomVerse support team works 24/7. Requests are usually received and handled within 15 - 30 minutes, and never later than 24 working hours.

faqs.q: Can I submit Anime or Gaming review articles to the website?
faqs.a: Absolutely! FandomVerse welcomes reviews, story analyses and news roundups from the community. Choose the "Content & Anime Contributions" topic to send your draft.

faqs.q: What is the warranty and return policy for Figures in the Shop?
faqs.a: All authentic Figure products come with a 1-for-1 exchange within 7 days for manufacturer defects or serious box damage during shipping.

faqs.q: Does FandomVerse host offline community events?
faqs.a: Every year we provide media sponsorship and run booths at major festivals such as AnimeJapan, Comic Con and Vietnam Game Day.
